messages:
Priya (Finance): @channel New billing change preview: starting 2026-09-01 were introducing a monthly "Starter Allotment" for new/free-tier accounts and an Early-Burst surcharge window for high first-week traffic. Goal: reduce invoice surprises and prevent short-lived signup spikes from destabilizing pools.

Priya (Finance): Key points: - Starter Allotment = fixed monthly credit for accounts created in the last 12 months; annual spend equivalent preserved for existing customers. - Early-Burst surcharge = a temporary per-minute surcharge applied only to usage in the first 7 days after account creation when usage exceeds Xx baseline.

Marco (Billing): Dev notes: implement preview CSV by 2026-08-10 listing accounts created in last 12 months and flagging those that would hit surcharge. CSV cols: account_id, created_at, projected_starter_alloc, first_week_usage, surcharge_eligible (bool), migration_id. We'll emit billing.event.starter_migration.v1 at cutover.

Tess (Product): Comms plan: console banner + signup modal notice for new accounts; 14-day opt-out for partners. Draft modal copy below.

Aisha (Support): Playbook: - If customer sees surcharge, explain it's limited to first 7 days and can be waived for bona fide trials. Escalate waivers to billing@. - Use preview CSV to confirm eligibility.

Darren (Legal): Add short footer: "Starter allotments and surcharges are account-specific; waiver requests are reviewed case-by-case." Will finalize wording.

ops-billing-bot: preview_job queued -> scheduled 2026-08-10T06:00:00Z

Priya (Finance): Timeline: 2026-08-10 preview CSV; 2026-08-20 signup modal + banner; 2026-09-01 cutover. Safety: if >0.3% new accounts hit surcharge in first 24h, throttle and rollback for 48h.

Tess (Product): Modal snippet:

"We give new accounts a Starter Allotment to make invoices predictable. Very high activity in your first 7 days may incur a temporary Early-Burst surcharge; contact support for trial waivers."

Aisha (Support): Will schedule 60-min training for agents 2026-08-22 and prep waiver form.

Marco (Billing): Sample support note:

"Hi <customer>, welcome! We granted your account a Starter Allotment. We see early burst charges; we can review and waive if this was a legitimate trial. Please share your trial scope. — Marco, Billing"

Priya (Finance): Action items: Marco -> preview CSV by 2026-08-10; Eng -> signup modal + preview API by 2026-08-20; Support -> training + waiver intake by 2026-08-22; Legal -> final footer by 2026-08-08.
